rounds.author: Big Mama
notes: Explosives on right and left cause
barricades to move into corners.

rounds.name: Rounding Off
rounds.author: Big Mama
notes: From Mamas Gauntlet 4.  The  changes
are the rings, removing the starfish
effects, making center circle wait for 2 hits,
removing most of the power ups, and
making most power ups bombs.

rounds.name: Let's Orbit A While
rounds.author: Big Mama
notes: Center of circle gives one ring and 3 balls
Other rings move up and down with
barricade.

rounds.name: Rotate It To Get Them All
rounds.author: Alf.
notes: Use the triggers to rotate the bricks.
Powerups are near the top.

rounds.name: Right Click For Help
rounds.author: Big Mama
notes: The focus here is the right click to destroy
the 3-hit bricks all in one swoop.

rounds.name: Assistance From The Switch
rounds.author: Sharon Hanlon
notes: Switch rotates on/off bricks which
open to the rings.  Player may be
trapped inside after getting rings,
but will be given ammo to clean
up remaining outside bricks

rounds.name: 3 Detonators
rounds.author: Alf
notes: on/off detonators will destroy explosives.
The top power ups will help to destroy the indestructibles.
Destroy the front line first.
